name: Cameroon
regionLevel: first-level division (ISO 3166-2), as in the N-Ways regions table

existing.system: No national postcode or address system in use. Campost (Cameroon Postal Services) uses P.O. boxes: 'BP 6000 YAOUNDÉ CAMEROUN' (UPU addressing sheet, 2002). Street names and numbers exist only in parts of Douala and Yaoundé (city-council street-naming schemes, e.g. 'Rue 1.055' in central Yaoundé in OSM); people give directions by quarter and landmark ('Akwa, derrière l'immeuble X').
existing.status: No digital national address or postcode project found as of 2026-10-17 (Campost's announced commune codes aside; an unpublished project cannot be ruled out).
existing.openData: No open national address register found. OSM has some street names and a few addr:street tags (e.g. Yaoundé 'Rue 1.055', Douala 'Boulevard du Président Ahmadou Ahidjo'); Overpass was unreachable so house-number counts were not taken.
existing.openAlgorithm: Open Location Code (Plus Codes) is open and free (Apache-2.0) and works offline; what3words is proprietary.
existing.terms: Plus Codes have no licence fee; OSM data is ODbL with attribution.
existing.recommendation: Coordinates plus Plus Codes (nways.ng/p/<code>) with OSM street names and quarter/landmark descriptions ('Akwa, Douala · en face de la SCB'). Accept 'BP' boxes as text only; they are not locations.

findings.name: City street naming (Douala, Yaoundé)
findings.format: street name or coded street ('Rue 1.055') + no reliable house numbers

sources.note: UPU addressing sheet for Cameroon (07/2002): example 'BP 6000 YAOUNDÉ CAMEROUN', no postcode

sources.buildings: OpenStreetMap (ODbL); Google Open Buildings (CC BY 4.0) and Microsoft building footprints (ODbL) via Overture Maps
